<div class="flourish-embed flourish-chart" data-src="visualisation/25403793?515064"><script src="https://public.flourish.studio/resources/embed.js"></script><noscript><img src="https://public.flourish.studio/visualisation/25403793/thumbnail" width="100%" alt="chart visualization" /></noscript></div>
```{r}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
#| results: asis
csv_name <- "chartbook_F12.csv"
csv_tmp  <- file.path(tempdir(), csv_name)
download.file(
  "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/GPID-WB/pip-chartbook/refs/heads/main/csv/chartbook_F12.csv",
  destfile = csv_tmp,
  mode = "wb",
  quiet = TRUE
)
# Plain <a download> holding the CSV as a data: URI.
# downloadthis::download_file() is deliberately NOT used here: the handler it
# generates calls fetch() on the data: URI, and PositConnect serves a
# Content-Security-Policy whose connect-src has no data:, so the fetch was
# blocked and the button failed with "Download failed. Please try again."
# An anchor download is not governed by any CSP directive.
cat(sprintf(
  '<div class="cell-output-display"><a class="btn btn-primary" href="data:text/csv;base64,%s" download="%s"><i class="bi bi-download"></i> Download data as csv</a></div>',
  xfun::base64_encode(csv_tmp), csv_name
))
```

<p style="font-size: 0.5em; color: #555; margin-top: 0.5em;">

Note: High-inequality economies have a Gini index above 40, moderate inequality economies are those with a Gini index between 30 and 40, and low-inequality economies are those with a Gini index below 30. The data cover all economies with at least one household survey in the Poverty and Inequality Platform after 2000. The Gini index is used from the latest survey year. Income group is based on the World Bank fiscal year 2027 list.The label values may not add to 100 percent due to rounding.

</p>
